card.name: Small linking words in section headings
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as to, for, with and having right after a noun, especially in drug label headings like 'Directions for' or 'Drugs with No Clinically...'. Also fires on a few mid-name pieces.

modes.label: Heading connectors
modes.description: A linking word right after 'Directions' or 'Drugs' in a numbered label heading.
modes.example: 2.5 Directions<< for>> Dispensing from Pharmacy Bulk Vial The

modes.label: Linking word in running text
modes.description: The word 'to' after a noun or adjective in a clinical sentence.
modes.example: Due to low binding<< to>> plasma proteins, famotidine is eliminated

modes.label: Partway through a name
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a drug name or a person's name.
modes.example: Dialysis is unlikely to be effective because macitent<<an>> is highly protein-bound.

card.plain: It marks small linking words like to and for that come right before the next phrase in label headings and sentences.
